content.content: Hello! I am your robot assistant. What is your name?
my name is Maddie and this is Kasia
Nice to meet you, Maddie and Kasia! Do you have a hobby you both enjoy?
we like football
Football sounds fun! Do you like watching it or playing it more?
I like playing it more
That’s great, Maddie! Do you play often?
yes but I am very bad at it
It's wonderful that you enjoy playing! Do you play with friends or a team?
we play with friends
That sounds like a lot of fun! Would you like to keep talking or take a break?
can you ask me something else
Of course! Do you have a favorite food you like?
I really like pasta
Pasta is delicious! Do you have a favorite kind of pasta?
I don't know if I like
That's okay! Do you like trying new pasta dishes?
not really
Got it! Do you have a favorite pasta dish you usually enjoy?
carbonara
Yum, carbonara is tasty! Is there anything else you'd like to talk about?
no thanks
Alright, Maddie. Thanks for chatting with me. Have a great day!
bye
It was lovely talking to you. Take care and goodbye!
